snippet.title: After-Image | Lever Softworks W.I.P F-Stop
snippet.description:
After-Image is a project in development by Lever Softworks aimed to recreate what F-Stop was.

While the leak from April 22, 2020 contained Team Fortress 2 and CS:GO source code, it also contained a semi-working build of After-Image. This gave me the chance and a few others to experience what Lever Softworks has to offer on delivering a F-Stop experience. The maps being shown here are compiled maps intended for an eventual demo, though clearly being incomplete. What Lever Softworks has to offer here is tremendous, and knowing what they've done in the past.. I don't think I can contain my excitement anymore for this. (Even though it may be a few years until the project is complete.)

Lever Softworks Twitter: https://twitter.com/LeverSoftworks
Lever Softworks ModDB: https://www.moddb.com/company/lever-softworks

F-Stop Wiki Article: https://vcc.wiki/wiki/F-Stop


I am also NOT affiliated with either Lever Softworks and/or Valve Software. (That's a given.)

After-Image and/or Lever Softworks is NOT affiliated with Valve Software AT ALL.
